notes:
Tasks, redesigned and simpler.

Two cards at the top, Assigned to me and Assigned by me, and one bar with Total,
Overdue, Pending, In review and Completed. Every task has a status menu: approve,
reject, delegate, transfer, send for review or complete. Filter by department,
person, due date and priority, or search by who gave the task or who it is for.
Anyone can give anyone a task; leave the person empty to assign it to yourself.
"Ask" is gone.

Alerts: swipe a notification right to mark it read (or unread again). Swipe left
and tap Delete to remove it.

Approvals: admins, the CEO and the MD now have one Approvals instead of two.

Payslips have separate View and Share buttons. Documents, bills, letters and other
PDFs or photos now open to view instead of going straight to share.

Lists you pick from open with the cursor already in the search box.

Salary advance requests are now the company's Advance Request Form: purpose, date
of disbursement, repayment months and the terms to accept. An advance can be up
to three months' salary.

The home-screen interview card keeps a round until its result is recorded, and
rounds on hold are listed separately.

Dark mode: dark, green and red buttons (such as Run payroll) are readable again.
The CEO and MD can open Payroll and Payslip Requests in view-only mode too.
